lines: A grey rook feather in the roost. The rooks pretend not to see you take it.
You got a grey feather.
A grey rook feather on top of the hoard. The only thing here nobody stole.
You got a grey feather.
A board at the gate, covered in scratched notes: 'Turn back.' 'No really.' 'Dimsy owes me money.'
Tip: the wall in each room lists the feathers in order. Read it top to bottom, and ignore Dimsy.
A long rook feather is pinned to the wall.

lines: Keeper: Who counts my coins? Nobody counts my coins. I count my coins.
Keeper: Every rook in Corvane brings me something shiny. You're shiny. Hold still.
Keeper: Fine. Take a handful. The rooks will just steal it back from you on the way home.
Keeper: Forty years I've guarded this hoard. Know what's in it? Buttons. Mostly buttons. And one spoon.
Kip: You're not Dimsy. Dimsy said he'd bring a mark. Are you the mark?
Kip: Right. You're not the mark. I'm the mark. Story of my life.
Kip: If you see Dimsy, tell him I want my half. He'll know which half.
Nance: Counting room's closed. Unless you're counting bruises.
Nance: Lovely. Now I've got bruises to count.
Nance: Three floors of feathers just to steal buttons. I need a new career.

gate_sign: The Rook Vault. Feathers open the doors. Rooks open your pockets.
